observation.command: cd /tmp && sed -n '/id="alert"/,/\/div>/p' resp.html | head -15; echo "=== cookie jar ==="; cat cj.txt; echo "=== try login, dump status and key markers ==="; rm -f cj2.txt; TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj2.txt http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in | grep -oE 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -v -b cj2.txt -c cj2.txt -X POST http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[email]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678" -o resp2.html 2>&1 | grep -E "^< HTTP|^< Set-Cookie"
